description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 223 You Are My Sunshine”, a bright and inviting coastal retreat located in the highly sought-after High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach. This beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo comfortably sleeps up to 8 guests and offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience and resort-style living. Wake up to Gulf views from your private balcony, spend your days lounging by the lagoon-style pool or walk just steps to the private beach access. With thoughtful interiors and access to premier amenities, this is the perfect place to relax, reconnect and soak in the best of 30A. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Sleeps 8 with 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathroomsLocated in High Pointe Resort with direct beach accessSpacious balcony with pool views and Gulf viewsResort-style lagoon pool just steps away1 seasonal beach chair setup included, 2 chairs and 1 umbrellaOn-site dining at Crabby Steve’s beachfront restaurant and bar2 bikes included for exploring 30AAccess to tennis courts, pickleball courts, shuffleboard and playground*** LIVING AREA ***The living space is warm, welcoming and filled with natural light, creating the perfect place to unwind after a day at the beach. With comfortable seating and easy access to the balcony, this space is ideal for relaxing or gathering with family and friends.Cozy living area with ample seating and flat-screen TVOpen-concept layout connecting living, dining and kitchenDirect access to the private balcony with pool and Gulf views*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The spacious kitchen is thoughtfully designed with modern finishes and everything you need to prepare meals with ease. Whether you're cooking breakfast before the beach or enjoying dinner at home, this space makes it simple to gather and connect.Modern appliances and sleek countertops with ample prep spaceBar seating for 4, perfect for casual meals or conversationDining area with seating for 4*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Step outside to your private balcony and take in the views of the sparkling community pool and the Gulf beyond. It’s the perfect place to start your morning or wind down in the evening with the coastal breeze.Private balcony with pool views and Gulf viewsIdeal for morning coffee, sunset drinks and relaxing outdoor moments*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Designed for both comfort and functionality, this condo offers flexible sleeping arrangements perfect for families or groups.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in showerBunk Room: Two twin-over-queen bunk beds, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower*** RESORT AMENITIES ***High Pointe Resort offers a true resort experience with a wide range of amenities designed for relaxation and fun.Lagoon-style pool with plenty of lounge seatingPrivate gated beach access just steps awayCrabby Steve’s beachfront restaurant and barTennis courts, 4 pickleball courts, shuffleboard and playgroundCharcoal BBQ grills and green space for outdoor enjoyment*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest Beach, High Pointe Resort places you within walking distance of some of 30A’s most iconic destinations.Peddler’s Pavilion: Just across the street with dining, shopping and live entertainmentRosemary Beach: 6-minute walk to charming streets, boutiques and cafésAlys Beach: Less than a mile away, known for its stunning architecture and serene atmosphereCarillon Beach: Short drive for additional dining and shopping options*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentAdditional bikes can be rented through La Dolce Vita for a fee*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A ESCAPES, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
